adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code now sets `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then persists `key` to Prisma. But `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (new in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) returns the Zod `SafeParseResult` object (with `{ success, data, ... }`), not the parsed credential payload itself. This means the credential `key` column would store the wrapper instead of the actual credential object, unlike the previous `googleCredentialSchema.parse(...)` behavior, and would break subsequent credential usage.
